items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Did he take Brock's place? ... Well, yeah, he was younger than Brock. I mean, he'd taken Brock's place.

ctx.x: Speaking of uptown fellows, what about Lorenzo Stahl? Did he take Brock's place? Was he a little younger than Brock or did he?
Well, yeah, he was younger than Brock. I mean, he'd taken Brock's place.
Oh, do you know that his last name, is it spelled, you know how it's spelled or pronounced exactly, is it Stahl or some people say Star, like the star up in the sky?
